search_console.decision: The report covered August 31 through September 27. The 510-thread battery page had 21 impressions, zero clicks, and average position 7.7, so its title, description, opening, hardware record, FAQ, sources, and internal paths were materially improved. Position 4-20 rows with only one to four impressions and a single Oklahoma query click were deliberately ignored as too weak.
